firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to support the Symbolic Care Hub website, focusing on service information and contact form submissions. Authorization Independence is achieved inherently as there's no cross-document authorization requirements, and each document stands alone. The structure segregates service information and contact form submissions into separate collections, each having distinct security needs and simplifying security rules. No `list` operations are protected in this basic version, but that would easily be added if the app required it. If admin users were created, their roles would live in collections such as `/roles_admin/{uid}`.
